name: Veil-9 Thermoptic Shroud
description:
The Veil-9 is a full-body garment woven from a proprietary metamaterial lattice developed by Arcturus Defense Solutions. Microscopic hexagonal cells across the fabric's surface sample ambient light data via embedded photodiodes and re-emit it on the opposite side, creating a passable optical camouflage effect that blends the wearer into static or slowly-changing backgrounds. The system draws power from a flexible spine battery integrated into the back panel, offering roughly four hours of continuous active cloaking before requiring a recharge cycle.

What distinguishes the Veil-9 from cheaper imitators is its thermal management layer — a secondary membrane of aerogel composite interwoven with micro-channel coolant tubing that actively redistributes body heat across a wider surface area, reducing the wearer's IR signature to roughly that of ambient architecture. It does not eliminate thermal output entirely, but it smears it into an indistinct warm haze rather than a recognizable human silhouette. Military-grade thermal optics at close range can still identify a user, but standard corporate security sweeps and drone packages typically fail to flag the signature.

The Veil-9 is almost exclusively found in the hands of corporate black-ops units, high-end fixers, and the occasional well-funded freelancer who can stomach the price. On the street it carries a reputation slightly larger than its actual performance warrants — the name 'Veil' has become shorthand in certain circles for any serious cloaking rig, regardless of brand.

specifications.thermal_suppression: Reduces IR signature to ~0.4x baseline human output
specifications.failure_mode: Visible shimmer distortion under rapid movement above 12 km/h
specifications.power_source: Integrated flexible spine battery, 3,400 mAh equivalent
specifications.form_factor: Full-body suit, hood included, gloves sold separately

tactical_use: Primarily used for static infiltration and slow-movement operations — entering secured facilities, holding position in surveillance dead zones, or shadowing targets through low-traffic corridors. Users are trained to move deliberately; the shimmer distortion that appears at speed is the shroud's most notorious liability and has burned more than a few operators who panicked. Often paired with signal masking gear to prevent the suit's own EM emissions from betraying a position.
cultural_context: Owning a Veil-9 in GLMZ signals that you either work for someone with serious resources or you've done something very specific and very dangerous to acquire one. The suits don't appear on any civilian market — every unit is theoretically serialized and tracked by Arcturus, though black-market units with scrubbed IDs circulate at extreme markup. Among street-level operators, wearing 'a Veil' is aspirational shorthand; actually wearing a real one marks you as someone who has moved past the amateur tier entirely.
story_hooks: A Veil-9 with an intact serial number surfaces on the black market — the number traces to a unit officially destroyed in a classified op three years ago. Someone is selling something they shouldn't have.
A player's contact goes silent mid-job; the only evidence they were ever there is a faint thermal smear on a security recording that the client swears is a ghost.

Arcturus quietly offers a bounty for the return of 'misappropriated assets' — no questions asked, significant payout. The assets in question are six Veil-9 suits, and whoever took them hasn't used them yet.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, form-fitting full-body garment resembling a high-tech tactical bodysuit. The surface exhibits a subtle iridescent shimmer across its weave, with a faint hexagonal lattice pattern visible under direct light. The material appears to shift and ripple slightly depending on viewing angle, creating an unsettling almost-invisible quality. Hood integrated, articulated at neck with micro-adjustment tabs.
physical_description.dimensions: Tailored to individual measurements; typical lay-flat dimensions approximately 160cm × 80cm when spread. Compact enough to roll into a backpack bundle when not worn.
physical_description.weight_description: Lightweight and wearable; 1.8 kg distributed across full body. Handheld when stored, requires wearing harness when active to avoid heat stress.
physical_description.primary_material: Proprietary metamaterial lattice weave with aerogel composite thermal layer. Surface feels like reinforced synthetic silk with subtle texture variation. Second-skin quality without being sticky.
physical_description.finish: Matte with micro-hexagonal cell pattern creating fractured light refraction. Surface is slightly hydrophobic. Back panel features reinforced stitching around integrated spine battery housing.
physical_description.color_scheme: Neutral gray-black base with oil-slick iridescent undertones. Seams and stress points reinforced with gunmetal thread. Battery spine panel marked with minimal anthracite ARCTURUS branding.
physical_description.interface_elements: Micro-toggle power switch concealed at left collarbone (3mm recessed). Standard charging port (micro-USB equivalent) on lower spine, protected by weatherproof flap. Subtle LED status indicator (orange = charging, green = ready, red = low battery) near left hip. No visible screen; tactile feedback only.
distinctive_features: Visible hexagonal honeycomb surface pattern catches light in hypnotic way
Back panel shows rigid spine of integrated battery as subtle linear ridge
Hood transitions smoothly into neck cowl with micro-articulated adjustment tabs
Material appears to ripple/shift slightly in peripheral vision even when stationary
Gloved wrists feature reinforced gripping zones with subtle grip-texture pattern
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: Small woven ARCTURUS DEFENSE SOLUTIONS logo near right hip (15mm × 10mm). Minimal serial number stamped on battery spine housing in machine-readable code. No other branding — stealth-focused design prioritizes anonymity.
physical_description.condition_typical: Worn as second skin under or over light tactical gear. Active use shows minor scuff marks on knees/elbows, faint cable creasing across back panel from battery flexing. Dust clings slightly to hexagonal surface pattern. When powered off, appears as unremarkable gray tactical suit; powered on, creates faint visual distortion halo.
